title: Set up project environment and dependencies
description: Initialize the project with Godot 4.5.1 .NET, .NET 8 SDK, and ensure packages.lock.json is present.
acceptance: task-0001.json must include machine-readable fields for godot_version, dotnet_version, packages_lock_exists, and evidence_paths; missing any field fails acceptance. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task1EnvironmentEvidencePersistenceTests.cs

task-0001.json must provide explicit pass/fail conclusions for Windows-only and UTF-8 compliance with traceable evidence sources; vague statements (for example, "checked") fail acceptance. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task1EnvironmentEvidencePersistenceTests.cs

ACCEPTANCE_CHECKLIST.md must list all evidence paths for Task 1, and every path must resolve to an existing file under logs/ci/<YYYY-MM-DD>/env-evidence/; any broken path fails acceptance. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task1EnvironmentEvidencePersistenceTests.cs

On Windows, GODOT_BIN must be set to the absolute path of the Godot 4.5.1 .NET console executable, and .NET-console flavor must be proven by both executable identity evidence and version-command output captured from that exact path; task-0001.json must record godot_bin_env.env_var_name="GODOT_BIN", godot_bin_env.env_var_value (absolute path), godot_bin_env.env_var_scope (Process/User/Machine), and installation verification result. Missing any required field or non-absolute path fails acceptance. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task1ToolchainVersionChecksTests.cs

Must execute `& $env:GODOT_BIN --version`; command must succeed and stdout must include "4.5.1". Running `godot --version` is optional evidence when PATH is configured; if provided, it must also report "4.5.1". Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task1ToolchainVersionChecksTests.cs

Must persist full stdout of `& $env:GODOT_BIN --version` to logs/ci/<YYYY-MM-DD>/env-evidence/godot-bin-version.txt; when `godot --version` is available, its full stdout must be persisted to logs/ci/<YYYY-MM-DD>/env-evidence/godot-version.txt. Missing required evidence file fails acceptance. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task1EnvironmentEvidencePersistenceTests.cs

task-0001.json must record command, exit_code, parsed_version, and evidence_file for each Godot version command; missing any key fails acceptance. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task1ToolchainVersionChecksTests.cs

After installing .NET 8 SDK, running `dotnet --version` must start with "8.", and `dotnet --list-sdks` must contain at least one 8.x SDK entry; 7.x, 9.x, empty output, missing 8.x SDK entry, or command failure fails acceptance. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task1ToolchainVersionChecksTests.cs

If packages.lock.json is missing before restore, running `dotnet restore .\NewRouge.sln` must generate it; if it already exists, it must remain present and correspond to the same NewRouge.sln restore scope. A lock file outside the NewRouge.sln restore scope does not satisfy acceptance. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task1DotnetRestoreLockfileTests.cs

Before toolchain checks are accepted, `.\NewRouge.sln` must exist in repository workspace and be the exact restore target used in evidence; missing solution file or mismatched restore target fails acceptance. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task1DotnetRestoreLockfileTests.cs

Must create logs/ directory structure for evidence, including at minimum logs/ci/<YYYY-MM-DD>/env-evidence/, and store readable evidence files covering Godot version checks, dotnet version, dotnet SDK list, packages.lock.json existence, Windows-only result, and UTF-8 result; any missing required directory or evidence file fails acceptance. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task1EnvironmentEvidencePersistenceTests.cs

Acceptance artifacts must explicitly back-link ADR-0031 and ADR-0011 (for example via refs in task-0001.json and ACCEPTANCE_CHECKLIST.md); missing either ADR reference fails acceptance. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task1EnvironmentEvidencePersistenceTests.cs

UTF-8 compliance must be validated at file level: task-0001.json, ACCEPTANCE_CHECKLIST.md, and generated evidence files under logs/ci/<YYYY-MM-DD>/env-evidence/ must decode as UTF-8 without errors; task-0001.json must include utf8_check.result="pass", utf8_check.checked_files (non-empty), and utf8_check.evidence_file. Any decode failure or missing required field fails acceptance. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task1EnvironmentEvidencePersistenceTests.cs

Windows-only is a hard gate: os_platform must be Windows, and task-0001.json must include windows_only_check.result="pass" with platform evidence. Non-Windows or missing evidence fails and must stop downstream gates. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task1WindowsPlatformGateTests.cs

Must persist full stdout of `dotnet restore .\NewRouge.sln` to logs/ci/<YYYY-MM-DD>/env-evidence/dotnet-restore.txt; missing evidence file fails acceptance. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task1DotnetRestoreLockfileTests.cs

task-0001.json must include dotnet_restore.command, dotnet_restore.exit_code, and dotnet_restore.evidence_file; dotnet_restore.command must target NewRouge.sln (semantic equivalent of `dotnet restore .\NewRouge.sln`), and dotnet_restore.exit_code must equal 0. Missing any key, wrong restore target, or non-zero exit_code fails acceptance. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task1DotnetRestoreLockfileTests.cs
test_strategy: Check Godot version via 'godot --version', .NET version via 'dotnet --version', and verify packages.lock.json exists. Log environment evidence to logs/ci/<YYYY-MM-DD>/env-evidence/. Refs: ADR-0031, ADR-0011.

title: Create core project structure and namespaces
description: Establish directory boundaries: Game.Core, Game.Godot, Game.Core.Tests, Tests.Godot. Enforce NewRouge.* namespace.
acceptance: Repository root must contain Game.Core/, Game.Godot/, Game.Core.Tests/, and Tests.Godot/. Refs: Tests.Godot/tests/Tasks/test_task0002_acceptance.gd Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task2NamespaceCoexistenceTests.cs Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task2RootBuildGateTests.cs

Game.Core/, Game.Core.Tests/, and Tests.Godot/ must each contain a .csproj with TargetFramework=net8.0 and Nullable=enable; Game.Godot/ is a script/resource directory and must not contain any standalone .csproj. Refs: Tests.Godot/tests/Tasks/test_task0002_acceptance.gd Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task2RootBuildGateTests.cs

Game.Core must not reference any Godot package or API. taskdoc/task-0002-change-set.json is the authoritative Task 2 C# scope and must include Game.Core/Conventions and Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task2* entries (plus optional Tests.Godot Task2 C# entries); every listed file must declare namespaces under NewRouge.*; legacy Game.* may remain outside Task 2 scope. Refs: Tests.Godot/tests/Tasks/test_task0002_acceptance.gd Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task2NamespaceCoexistenceTests.cs Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task2RootBuildGateTests.cs

If legacy Game.* namespaces are present, they may coexist with NewRouge.*; Task 2 does not require full repository rename. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task2NamespaceCoexistenceTests.cs Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task2RootBuildGateTests.cs

Task 2 completion must include sc-acceptance-check step `dotnet-build-warnaserror` with exit_code=0 as root build proof; if this gate is not executed or fails, Task 2 must remain non-done and progression must be blocked. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task2RootBuildGateTests.cs
test_strategy: Validate root directories and .csproj settings for Game.Core, Game.Core.Tests, and Tests.Godot; treat Game.Godot as script/resource directory. Refs: ADR-0024.
Gate evidence: root build pass is enforced by sc-acceptance-check dotnet-build-warnaserror (exit code 0, no compiler errors), and Task2RootBuildGateTests validates build output classification.
Evidence note: structure snapshot may be stored as logs/ci/<date>/task-0002-structure.txt for review traceability.
Evidence note: capture sc-acceptance-check summary at logs/ci/<YYYY-MM-DD>/sc-acceptance-check-task-2/summary.json and keep dotnet-build-warnaserror step status for audit (non-Refs evidence).

title: Implement core contracts for card identity and forms
description: Define contracts in Game.Core/Contracts for card identity, forms (Base, U1A, U1B, Ultimate), and upgrade fields per ADR-0033.
acceptance: 在 Game.Core/Contracts 中定义 CardDefinition 与 CardInstance 契约：CardDefinition 至少包含 card_id，CardInstance 至少包含 instance_id、upgrade_tier、upgrade_route、permanent_card_instance_modifiers；并定义 Form 枚举（Base/U1A/U1B/Ultimate）与 Route 枚举（A/B）。上述契约需可被纯 .NET 测试项目直接引用并编译通过，且不得依赖任何 Godot 类型或命名空间。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task0003AcceptanceTests.cs

升级语义必须可被测试直接判定：当 upgrade_tier=2 时，upgrade_route 必须为 null；当 upgrade_tier 不为 2 且提供 upgrade_route 时，其值仅允许 A 或 B。对违反“tier=2 且 route 非 null”的输入，测试必须产生显式失败结果，且不能通过跳过断言、空测试、默认值回退或静默修正掩盖问题。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task0003AcceptanceTests.cs
在 Game.Core.Tests/Contracts 下新增或更新 xUnit 测试，覆盖契约字段定义、Form/Route 枚举成员完整性、以及 tier=2→route=null 约束的正反两类用例；并验证测试工程保持纯 .NET 依赖且未引入 Godot 依赖。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task0003AcceptanceTests.cs

In Game.Core/Contracts, CardDefinition and CardInstance must be interface or class (record class allowed); reflection tests assert IsInterface or IsClass and reject other shapes. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task0003AcceptanceTests.cs

Game.Core.Tests/Contracts must include reflection assertions that CardDefinition and CardInstance are IsInterface or IsClass (including record class); any other type shape fails acceptance. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task0003AcceptanceTests.cs

Negative tests must assert explicit failure when CardDefinition or CardInstance is struct, enum, or any non interface/class shape; missing negative gate fails acceptance. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task0003AcceptanceTests.cs
test_strategy: Write xUnit tests in Game.Core.Tests/Contracts to validate contract definitions and upgrade field constraints. Ensure no Godot dependencies. Refs: ADR-0033, ADR-0020.

title: Implement core contracts for offer locking and deterministic outcomes
description: Define contracts for offer locking structure, provenance, and RNG streams per ADR-0032 and Design Gate 05.
acceptance: OfferLockSnapshot and OfferProvenance must be concrete C# contract types in the contracts layer and instantiable in tests; schema-only or dictionary-only representations are not acceptable. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Domain/OfferLockingContractTests.cs

OfferLockSnapshot must expose stable_ids, display_order, provenance, rng_stream, and locked_at_save_point semantics (implemented as IsLockedAtSavePoint); reflection must verify field existence and types, and Provenance must round-trip as a value object. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Domain/OfferLockingContractTests.cs

OfferProvenance must expose source_type, source_id, act, floor, node_id, difficulty, rng_stream, and stream_pos; reflection must verify field existence and types. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Domain/OfferLockingContractTests.cs
OfferLockSnapshot.rng_stream must stay consistent with OfferProvenance.rng_stream in constructed samples. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Domain/OfferLockingContractTests.cs
Offer locking snapshots must preserve provenance stream_pos and carry lock-context boolean semantic for save-point state. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Domain/OfferLockingContractTests.cs

RNG stream categories must be exactly run, combat, event, loot, shop, and offer; missing any one is a hard fail. OfferLockSnapshot.RngStream and OfferProvenance.RngStream must validate against this closed set, and unknown values must fail contract validation tests. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Domain/RngStreamTypeTests.cs, Game.Core.Tests/Domain/OfferLockingContractTests.cs
stable_ids must be content-stable IDs; changing display_order only must not change the stable_ids set. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Domain/OfferLockingDeterminismTests.cs

locked_at_save_point must be represented as explicit boolean semantic (IsLockedAtSavePoint) and remain reproducible for the same lock context; LockedAt timestamp, if present, is informational. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Domain/OfferLockingContractTests.cs

Serialization round-trip must preserve OfferLockSnapshot data; identical inputs (including rng_stream and stream_pos) must produce identical outputs, and changing rng_stream or stream_pos must keep stable_ids content-stable while the changed context is reflected in provenance fields. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Domain/OfferLockingDeterminismTests.cs

For identical lock inputs (context, candidates, provenance, save-point flag), deterministic retrieval semantics must return equivalent snapshots (StableIds, DisplayOrder, Provenance.RngStream, Provenance.StreamPosition, IsLockedAtSavePoint). Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Domain/OfferLockingContractTests.cs
test_strategy: Write xUnit tests to validate offer locking structure and provenance fields. Test serialization/deserialization for deterministic behavior. Refs: ADR-0032.

title: Implement core contracts for status and modifier system
description: Define contracts for status types (Buff, Debuff, RuleModifier), fields, and deterministic ordering per Design Gate 04.
acceptance: 可通过契约定义与测试断言验证：StatusType 枚举包含 Buff、Debuff、RuleModifier，且定义 ExpiresTiming 枚举；Status 至少包含 status_id、stacks、duration_turns、source_id、expires_timing、strength 字段；执行驱散时 RuleModifier 与 status.strength 相关效果不会被移除；同一输入集合按 stable_id 排序时输出顺序恒定。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task0005AcceptanceTests.cs
对同一初始状态执行同一操作序列时，Status 的叠加、duration_turns 累计与衰减结果必须一致且可断言；当操作不满足生效条件时，状态保持不变，并可通过前后状态对比直接验证。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task0005AcceptanceTests.cs
xUnit 测试必须覆盖叠加规则、持续时长处理、驱散边界（含 RuleModifier 与 strength 不可驱散）以及 stable_id 排序确定性；任一规则被破坏时，至少一个对应测试用例失败。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task0005AcceptanceTests.cs
Status 契约必须显式提供叠加、持续时长累计、衰减三个可调用方法（命名可等价）；任一方法缺失、不可访问或无法被 xUnit 直接断言即判定失败。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task0005AcceptanceTests.cs
ADR-0021 and ADR-0029 must be present in task=5 adr_refs of both tasks_back.json and tasks_gameplay.json; any missing or mismatch must fail. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task0005AcceptanceTests.cs

ADR-0021 and ADR-0029 listed in ACCEPTANCE_CHECKLIST.md section "Task5 ADR Mapping" must exactly match task=5 adr_refs in both task views; any mismatch must fail. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task0005AcceptanceTests.cs

Status must be a C# class (record class allowed), not a struct or interface; xUnit must assert typeof(Status).IsClass == true and fail on any non-class shape. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task0005AcceptanceTests.cs
test_strategy: Write xUnit tests for status operations: stacking, duration handling, and dispel boundaries. Validate deterministic ordering via stable_id sorting. Refs: ADR-0021, ADR-0029.

title: Implement core contracts for combat loop and resolution pipeline
description: Define contracts for combat phases, damage calculation, and deterministic sequencing per Design Gates 01 and 03.
acceptance: Deliverables must provide executable contracts for four groups: CombatLoop phases, PlayCard resolution pipeline, damage calculation rules, and OverplayTax difficulty threshold. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Services/CombatServiceTests.cs
xUnit must contain behavior assertions for phase transitions, pipeline order/short-circuit, damage rules, and OverplayTax plus determinism. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Services/CombatServiceTests.cs

Referenced test files must contain executable assertions that prove Task6 contract obligations; stale, missing, or non-executable references fail semantic acceptance. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Services/CombatServiceTests.cs
CombatLoop contract must expose exactly four phases: StartOfTurn, Draw, Main, EndOfTurn; missing or extra phases fail acceptance. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Services/CombatServiceTests.cs

PlayCard pipeline contract must enforce the exact canonical sequence Validate->ComputeCost->PayCost->BeforePlayTriggers->ResolveEffect->AfterPlayTriggers->MoveCard->DeathCheck, with no missing, extra, or reordered steps. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Services/CombatServiceTests.cs

Damage contract must apply Strength, Weak, and Vulnerable multipliers to mutable damage, and fixed damage must remain exempt from mutable multipliers. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Domain/ValueObjects/DamageTests.cs
OverplayTax must be enabled only when difficulty >= 10 and must be disabled when difficulty < 10, with explicit boundary assertions. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Services/CombatServiceTests.cs

Deterministic ordering must use combatant_id and stable_id to produce stable sequence output, and repeated runs of the same input must stay identical. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Services/CombatServiceTests.cs

Task6 suite must include both positive and negative paths for transitions, pipeline behavior, damage rules, OverplayTax behavior, and deterministic outcomes. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Services/CombatServiceTests.cs Game.Core.Tests/Domain/ValueObjects/DamageTests.cs
Phase transition guards must reject invalid transitions and preserve unchanged combat state on rejection. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Services/CombatServiceTests.cs

Task6 contract behavior must stay consistent with ADR-0021 (state machine boundaries) and ADR-0032 (determinism), and tests must assert that alignment. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task0006CombatContractsTraceabilityTests.cs
When Validate fails, pipeline execution must stop at Validate and must not execute ComputeCost or any later step, with critical state unchanged. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Services/CombatServiceTests.cs
xUnit must include an explicit Validate-failure case asserting step trace stops at Validate and state remains unchanged. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Services/CombatServiceTests.cs
Tests must assert both valid and invalid phase transition behavior, including guard rejection and unchanged state on invalid transitions. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/State/CombatLoopPhaseTransitionTests.cs
Cover OverplayTax boundary at difficulty 9 and 10 with explicit assertions for taxed-cost applied vs not-applied behavior. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Services/CombatServiceTests.cs
All deterministic cases must produce identical outputs for identical inputs and identical initial state, independent of run count. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Services/CombatServiceTests.cs
[OBL:T6.O10] Damage coverage must execute a representative input matrix that proves multiplier and fixed-damage behavior across scenarios. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Domain/ValueObjects/DamageTests.cs

[OBL:T6.O10] Multiplier and fixed-damage scenarios must include normal cases, boundary cases, and negative/invalid inputs. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Domain/ValueObjects/DamageTests.cs Game.Core.Tests/Services/CombatServiceTests.cs
[OBL:T6.O10] Table-driven damage tests must verify multiplier math, fixed-damage invariants, and deterministic numeric outputs. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Domain/ValueObjects/DamageTests.cs
[OBL:T6.O15] CombatLoop must be implemented as an instantiable C# contract type in Game.Core and directly usable by tests. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Services/CombatServiceTests.cs
[OBL:T6.O15] Contract completion requires executable behavior verified by tests, not descriptive-only declarations. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Services/CombatServiceTests.cs
[OBL:T6.O15] CombatLoop implementation must be located under Game.Core/Contracts/Combat and referenced by tests. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Services/CombatServiceTests.cs
PlayCard resolution must apply OverplayTax in ComputeCost and consume taxed cost in PayCost when difficulty >= 10. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Services/CombatServiceTests.cs
When ComputeCost or PayCost fails, pipeline must stop immediately at the failing step and keep critical combat state unchanged. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Services/CombatServiceTests.cs

For the same PlayCardPipelineInput and same initial state, repeated runs must produce identical ExecutedSteps, StateAfter, and ExecutionFingerprint. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Services/CombatServiceTests.cs

When any post-cost step (BeforePlayTriggers, ResolveEffect, AfterPlayTriggers, MoveCard, DeathCheck) fails, execution must stop at the failing step and keep critical combat state unchanged. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Services/CombatServiceTests.cs

PlayCard pipeline and damage calculation must be defined as explicit executable contract types under Game.Core/Contracts/Combat (or subfolders), and tests must reference those contract types directly instead of only service-side implicit behavior. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Services/CombatServiceTests.cs Game.Core.Tests/Domain/ValueObjects/DamageTests.cs

Deterministic sequencing contract must define comparator precedence (combatant_id first, stable_id second) and deterministic tie handling for equal keys, and tests must assert this rule explicitly. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Services/CombatServiceTests.cs
test_strategy: Write xUnit tests for combat phase transitions, damage calculation, and OverplayTax application. Ensure deterministic ordering via combatant_id and stable_id. Refs: ADR-0021, ADR-0032.

title: Set up event bus and contracts location
description: Implement event bus system and place contracts in Game.Core/Contracts per ADR-0004 and ADR-0020.
acceptance: 在 Game.Core/Contracts 中提供事件总线接口，包含发布与订阅方法；该目录为唯一契约来源，Godot 层仅通过引用使用且不复制契约。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task0007AcceptanceTests.cs
提供 xUnit 用例覆盖事件发布与订阅的可用性，并在 Windows 上可用 `dotnet test` 通过。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task0007AcceptanceTests.cs
docs/architecture/overlays/PRD-NEWROUGE-GAME-0001/08/ACCEPTANCE_CHECKLIST.md 的 Test-Refs 指向本任务新增或更新的 xUnit 用例路径。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task0007AcceptanceTests.cs
在 Game.Core/Contracts 中至少定义 CardPlayed 与 CombatStarted 两个事件 DTO，并包含可区分事件的类型常量或字段。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Domain/GameEventContractsTests.cs
在组合根完成 EventBus 的依赖注入配置，Godot 层通过接口获取该 EventBus 并能调用。 Refs: Tests.Godot/tests/Adapters/test_event_bus_adapter.gd
Godot 层发布或订阅事件时使用 Game.Core.Contracts 中的 DTO 类型，仓库内不存在 Godot 层新增的同名契约定义文件。 Refs: Tests.Godot/tests/Adapters/test_event_bus_adapter.gd Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task0007AcceptanceTests.cs
可通过测试或检索证据确认：契约文件位于 Game.Core/Contracts 且 Godot 层无重复 DTO 定义。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Utilities/ContractsLocationAndDuplicationTests.cs

EventBus 的任务验收必须覆盖并验证以下领域事件可发布/可订阅：core.combat.started、core.combat.card.played、core.reward.offer.locked、core.autosave.written、core.run.state.transitioned；任一事件缺失则验收失败。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task0007AcceptanceTests.cs
test_strategy: Write xUnit tests for event publishing and subscription. Verify contracts are in correct location and not duplicated in Godot scripts. Refs: ADR-0004, ADR-0020.

title: Implement core logic for card identity and forms
description: Create core services for card definition, instance management, and form transitions per ADR-0033.
acceptance: CardService 对外提供按 card_id 获取定义、创建实例、U1 升级与 Ultimate 进阶；合法输入产生可观测且可断言的形态/层级变化，非法输入返回确定性失败并保持实例状态不变。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Services/CardServiceTests.cs
按 card_id 查询定义时，命中返回唯一对应的 CardDefinition，未命中产生可重复验证的确定性失败结果（同类输入得到同类失败输出）。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Services/CardServiceTests.cs
创建 CardInstance 时必须初始化 instance_id、base form 与修饰符容器，并保持卡牌定义与实例身份分离（实例变更不回写定义）。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Services/CardServiceTests.cs
实例在升级与 Ultimate 形态迁移后，permanent_card_instance_modifiers 按继承语义完整保留且可通过测试比对；若迁移被拒绝，修饰符与形态均保持原值。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Services/CardServiceTests.cs Game.Core.Tests/Domain/CardInstanceTests.cs
upgrade_tier 与 upgrade_route 必须联合校验，U1 仅接受受支持路线组合；非法 tier/route 组合触发硬失败且实例状态（形态、层级、修饰符）不发生变化。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Services/CardServiceTests.cs
xUnit 测试覆盖卡牌身份、card_id 查找命中/未命中、U1 路线升级、Ultimate 进阶与修饰符继承，并在测试描述中显式引用 ADR-0033。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Services/CardServiceTests.cs Game.Core.Tests/Domain/ValueObjects/CardIdentityTests.cs
与本任务对应的 xUnit 用例位于 Game.Core.Tests/Cards，能够直接定位并复现上述验收断言。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Services/CardServiceTests.cs
When a card enters Ultimate form, it must override prior U1A/U1B gameplay effect definitions and become the active form. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Services/CardServiceTests.cs
Ultimate transition must preserve existing permanent_card_instance_modifiers on the same card instance. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Services/CardServiceTests.cs
xUnit must verify card_id lookup hit and miss behavior with deterministic failure outputs. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Services/CardServiceTests.cs

CardDefinition and CardInstance contract fields must be non-empty and assertion-readable in tests. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Contracts/CardContractsTests.cs Game.Core.Tests/Contracts/ContractInstantiationCoverageTests.cs
xUnit must verify deterministic mapping from form transitions to visible effect description keys. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Services/CardServiceTests.cs
xUnit must verify route constraints and tier-route invariants for all legal and illegal inputs. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Services/CardServiceTests.cs
[OBL:T8.O10] 创建 CardInstance 后，实例字段必须与合同字段一一对应；缺失或额外字段均判失败。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Contracts/ContractInstantiationCoverageTests.cs Game.Core.Tests/Contracts/CardContractsTests.cs
[OBL:T8.O10] 对合同字段的默认值与类型进行可重复断言。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Contracts/CardContractsTests.cs
[OBL:T8.O10] CardInstance initialization must be explicitly validated as consistent with contract fields. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Contracts/ContractInstantiationCoverageTests.cs
[OBL:T8.O13] xUnit 必须断言 card_id miss 的 deterministic failure outputs（错误类型与错误码固定）。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Services/CardServiceTests.cs

title: Set up Godot autoloads and composition root

所有可见文本（按钮与对话框）均来自翻译资源，界面无硬编码展示文本。 Refs: Tests.Godot/tests/UI/test_main_menu_translations.gd
点击 Quit 会触发退出流程并关闭应用。 Refs: Tests.Godot/tests/UI/test_main_menu_events.gd
提供主菜单 UI 流程的手动测试记录，覆盖 New Run 覆盖确认与 Continue 有效 autosave。 Refs: Tests.Godot/tests/Tasks/test_task0014_acceptance.gd
手动测试记录可审计（文件或清单）。 Refs: Tests.Godot/tests/Tasks/test_task0014_acceptance.gd
验收项需检查 ADR-0032 与 ADR-0010 的引用或回链。 Refs: Tests.Godot/tests/Tasks/test_task0014_acceptance.gd
test_strategy: Manual testing of UI flow: new run with overwrite confirm, continue when autosave exists. Write GdUnit4 tests for button interactions and translation loading. Refs: ADR-0032, ADR-0010.

title: Implement difficulty selection UI
description: Create DifficultySelect.tscn with 10 difficulty levels and descriptions per M1 requirements.
acceptance: 界面加载后可见且可操作难度选择控件，难度项数量固定为10个（非9或11），并且用户可在界面内切换当前选中项且选中状态可见。 Refs: Tests.Godot/tests/Tasks/test_task0015_acceptance.gd
每个难度项都显示说明文本；说明仅聚焦数值挑战强度，不暗示与天赋树强绑定；文本通过本地化/翻译资源展示。 Refs: Tests.Godot/tests/Tasks/test_task0015_acceptance.gd
用户确认后的难度选择会写入全局状态；重新进入难度选择界面或相关界面时会读取并显示该已选难度，未重新选择时该值不应变化。 Refs: Tests.Godot/tests/Tasks/test_task0015_acceptance.gd
支持键盘/鼠标或手柄在10个难度选项间导航并确认选择，确认后当前选中项与最终生效的难度一致。 Refs: Tests.Godot/tests/UI/test_difficulty_select_input_navigation.gd Tests.Godot/tests/UI/test_difficulty_select_confirm_selection.gd
难度选择交互形态限定为按钮或滑块之一，并可通过该控件完成10级难度选择。 Refs: Tests.Godot/tests/Tasks/test_task0015_acceptance.gd
提供UI导航测试用例，覆盖键盘/鼠标/手柄输入下的难度选择流程，并对导航与确认结果进行断言。 Refs: Tests.Godot/tests/Tasks/test_task0015_acceptance.gd
提供难度持久化测试用例，验证确认选择后重新进入界面仍能读取并展示已选难度，且不会被静默重置为默认值。 Refs: Tests.Godot/tests/Tasks/test_task0015_acceptance.gd
提供可审计用例，验证说明文本不暗示与天赋树强绑定，且可在UI或本地化资源层定位并检查对应文本。 Refs: Tests.Godot/tests/Tasks/test_task0015_acceptance.gd
test_strategy: Test UI navigation and difficulty persistence. Verify descriptions do not imply strong binding to talent tree. Refs: ADR-0010, ADR-0032.

title: Implement character selection UI for Warrior only
description: Create CharacterSelect.tscn with Warrior as only selectable character and mechanism summary per M1 requirements.
acceptance: 在 CharacterSelect.tscn 中仅 Warrior 处于可选状态；其余角色被隐藏或置灰并显示“not open”标签，且可观察到选中状态变化。 Refs: Tests.Godot/tests/Tasks/test_task0016_acceptance.gd
在 Windows 环境打开 CharacterSelect.tscn 时可看到 Warrior 选项，界面能加载并完成基础交互（如切换/选择）。 Refs: Tests.Godot/tests/Tasks/test_task0016_acceptance.gd
Overlay 的 Test-Refs 清单包含本任务用例并保持可追踪。 Refs: Tests.Godot/tests/Tasks/test_task0016_acceptance.gd
Warrior 的机制摘要显示为三行文本，语义分别覆盖：怒气作为状态增益、强力攻击窗口、代价与爆发。 Refs: Tests.Godot/tests/Scenes/CharacterSelect/test_character_select_warrior_summary.gd
机制摘要三行文本来自翻译键而非硬编码；切换语言后三行内容同步变化。 Refs: Tests.Godot/tests/UI/test_settings_locale.gd
除 Warrior 外其他角色不可被选中，点击或键盘操作不触发其选中状态。 Refs: Tests.Godot/tests/Scenes/CharacterSelect/test_character_select_locked_characters_unselectable.gd
gameplay:X: “not open”标签来自翻译键，切换语言时同步变化。 Refs: Tests.Godot/tests/Tasks/test_task0016_acceptance.gd
test_strategy: Verify Warrior selection works and other characters are not selectable. Check translation keys for mechanism summary. Refs: ADR-0010.

title: Create modular Act structure for map system
description: Implement map system with modular Act structure, not hardcoded to 3 Acts, per M1 requirements.
acceptance: 当Act数量配置为2、4、5时，地图构建与导航初始化均成功，且不会触发由固定3个Act假设导致的失败；自动化验收中至少一个非3 Act配置通过。 Refs: Tests.Godot/tests/Tasks/test_task0017_acceptance.gd
在Windows环境下执行本任务验收时，地图初始化、节点展示与分叉选择流程均可完成；同一输入重复执行时得到一致的可观察结果，否则判定不通过。 Refs: Tests.Godot/tests/Tasks/test_task0017_acceptance.gd
Overlay中的Test-Refs可直接定位到本任务的地图导航与Act结构测试文件；若ACCEPTANCE_CHECKLIST中的对应路径不存在或无法核对通过状态，则判定不通过。 Refs: Tests.Godot/tests/Tasks/test_task0017_acceptance.gd
Game.Core提供MapService用于Act与地图节点管理；给定固定输入时可断言节点集合、连接关系或状态变化，且对应单元测试通过。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Services/MapServiceTests.cs
Map.tscn中可识别到Combat、Event、Shop、Rest四类节点图标或等价可识别表现；缺失任一类型即判定不通过。 Refs: Tests.Godot/tests/Scenes/Map/test_map_node_icons_presence.gd
地图支持分叉选择：在同一初始状态下选择不同分支后，可达节点集合或后续路径至少存在一处可观察差异；若无差异则判定不通过。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Services/MapBranchSelectionTests.cs Tests.Godot/tests/Scenes/Map/test_map_branch_selection_paths.gd
进入任一节点前会保存node_pre_enter状态；进入后可通过读取状态或测试断言确认已保存且与进入前一致，未保存或不一致即判定失败。 Refs: Tests.Godot/tests/Scenes/Map/test_map_node_pre_enter_state.gd
存在xUnit用例验证Act结构为可配置数量而非固定3个；用例能够区分满足条件时的成功与不满足条件时的失败。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Services/MapActConfigurationTests.cs
存在可重复执行的用例验证地图导航与节点选择行为，至少覆盖一次有效节点选择及其对应状态转移结果，并可稳定复现。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Services/MapNavigationSelectionTests.cs Tests.Godot/tests/Integration/test_map_navigation_state_transitions.gd
验收材料或变更记录中可检索到ADR-0007与ADR-0021的引用，并能对应到本任务的MapService与地图契约决策；缺失任一引用即判定不通过。 Refs: Tests.Godot/tests/Tasks/test_task0017_acceptance.gd
[OBL:T17.O8] 当在分叉节点提交非法分支ID时，系统必须拒绝本次选择，当前节点与可达节点集合保持不变。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Services/MapServiceTests.cs Tests.Godot/tests/Scenes/Map/test_map_fork_invalid_branch_rejected.gd
[OBL:T17.O8] 同一非法输入重复执行时结果一致，并可通过xUnit或Godot测试断言未发生状态推进。 Refs: Tests.Godot/tests/Scenes/Map/test_map_fork_invalid_branch_rejected.gd Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task0017AcceptanceTests.cs

[OBL:T17.O8] 分叉选择接收无效分支输入时必须拒绝前进，且当前导航状态保持不变（must not advance / state unchanged）。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Services/MapServiceTests.cs Tests.Godot/tests/Scenes/Map/test_map_fork_invalid_branch_rejected.gd
test_strategy: Test map navigation and node selection. Write xUnit tests for Act structure modularity. Refs: ADR-0007, ADR-0021.

title: Implement combat scene UI shell and bindings
description: Create Combat.tscn UI layout and bind to core combat state.
acceptance: 加载 Combat.tscn 后，场景内必须存在且默认可见用于手牌显示、能量显示、抽牌堆显示、弃牌堆显示以及回合控制（开始/结束或等价控制）的 HUD 元素，并可被自动化测试稳定定位。 Refs: Tests.Godot/tests/Scenes/Combat/test_combat_scene_ui_bindings.gd
当注入核心战斗状态快照时，Combat.tscn 的 UI 显示必须与状态逐项一致：手牌列表、当前能量值、抽牌堆数量、弃牌堆数量均可被逐项断言，不得以固定占位值通过验收。 Refs: Tests.Godot/tests/Scenes/Combat/test_combat_scene_ui_bindings.gd
当核心战斗状态发生变化（如手牌增减、能量变化、牌堆计数变化）时，现有 UI 必须同步反映新值；同一输入状态应产生同一显示结果，且变化可通过可观察输出或自动化断言验证。 Refs: Tests.Godot/tests/Scenes/Combat/test_combat_scene_ui_bindings.gd
本场景仅负责回合控制 UI 外壳与命令派发边界：交互事件必须路由至命令处理器，场景层不得直接变更核心状态、执行规则结算或推进完整回合；在无外部流程接管或动作为无效时，状态保持不变且不得自行推进回合。 Refs: Tests.Godot/tests/Scenes/Combat/test_combat_scene_turn_control_localization_smoke.gd

提供 GdUnit4 用例，至少覆盖 Combat.tscn 关键 UI 组件存在性与默认可见、对核心状态读取与变更同步、回合控制交互派发与无效动作阻止、可见文本通过本地化键解析，以及 headless 冒烟可执行路径。 Refs: Tests.Godot/tests/Scenes/Combat/test_combat_scene_ui_bindings.gd Tests.Godot/tests/Scenes/Combat/test_combat_scene_turn_control_localization_smoke.gd
Task 18 的验收必须包含可审计的架构边界检查并对齐 ADR-0022 与 ADR-0010（UI shell boundary、state-binding boundary、no scene-responsibility overflow）；缺失任一检查即验收失败。 Refs: Tests.Godot/tests/Tasks/test_task0018_acceptance.gd
Task 18 的验收必须包含可审计的测试策略检查并对齐 ADR-0025（test layering、assertion granularity、failure output quality、reproducible gates）；缺少策略证据即验收失败。 Refs: Tests.Godot/tests/Tasks/test_task0018_acceptance.gd
test_strategy: GdUnit4 tests for UI presence and bindings to state. Refs: ADR-0025.

title: Implement reward scene with card three-choice-one and offer locking
description: Create Reward.tscn with three card choices, offer locking, and deterministic display per ADR-0032.
acceptance: 进入 Reward.tscn 时，界面上同时且仅显示 3 张可选卡牌，且每张卡牌都可见名称、描述与形态标识（Base/U1A/U1B/Ultimate）。 Refs: Tests.Godot/tests/Scenes/Reward/test_reward_scene_three_cards_rendered.gd
在同一次奖励展示中，玩家最多只能确认 1 张卡牌；任意一张确认后，其余 2 张必须立即不可确认，且后续操作不会再次产生确认结果。 Refs: Tests.Godot/tests/Scenes/Reward/test_reward_scene_single_confirm_lock.gd Game.Core.Tests/Services/RewardSelectionServiceTests.cs

首次展示该轮奖励时，系统必须锁定当前 offer 并写入自动存档；在未生成新 offer 的前提下，退出并重新进入后展示的三卡内容与顺序保持一致。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Services/RewardOfferLockingServiceTests.cs Tests.Godot/tests/Integration/test_reward_offer_lock_persist_reenter.gd
执行“跳过”后 RNG 状态不得前进；在未生成新 offer 的前提下再次进入奖励界面时，仍展示同一组三卡。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Services/RewardOfferRngStateTests.cs Tests.Godot/tests/Scenes/Reward/test_reward_scene_skip_preserves_offer.gd
奖励界面所有可见文案必须来自翻译资源，界面中不得出现硬编码业务文案。 Refs: Tests.Godot/tests/UI/test_reward_ui_translations.gd
必须存在 xUnit 用例覆盖 offer 锁定逻辑，并验证退出后再次进入时仍读取并展示同一 offer。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Services/RewardOfferLockingServiceTests.cs

必须存在覆盖奖励展示、单选确认与跳过流程的验证用例，并包含退出后再次进入仍保持同一 offer 的场景断言。 Refs: Tests.Godot/tests/Scenes/Reward/test_reward_scene_confirm_and_skip_flow.gd Tests.Godot/tests/Integration/test_reward_offer_lock_persist_reenter.gd

Task 19 implementation and test artifacts must explicitly trace to ADR-0032 and ADR-0010 (for example in refs fields, checklist mapping, or test annotations); missing either ADR id fails acceptance. Refs: Tests.Godot/tests/Tasks/test_task0019_acceptance.gd

Task 19 acceptance must include an auto-checkable ADR linkage gate that verifies ADR-0032 and ADR-0010 are both present and consistent across task evidence; any mismatch fails acceptance. Refs: Tests.Godot/tests/Tasks/test_task0019_acceptance.gd
test_strategy: Test reward display, selection, and skip. Verify offer locking by exiting and re-entering. Write xUnit tests for offer locking logic. Refs: ADR-0032, ADR-0010.

title: Implement shop scene with inventory locking and no upgrade context
description: Create Shop.tscn with purchasable items, inventory locking, and no upgrade services per M1 requirements.
acceptance: 进入商店时必须加载 Shop.tscn，并展示可购买的卡牌与遗物及其价格；本次进入后库存与价格保持锁定，退出后再次进入时除已购买条目外，其余库存与价格与锁定时一致。 Refs: Tests.Godot/tests/Tasks/test_task0020_acceptance.gd
在商店完成购买后，被购买条目必须立即从可购列表移除并标记为已购买/已拥有；商店提供且可执行移除与重铸服务，同时不存在任何升级/Upgrade 服务入口或按钮，UI 文案来自本地化系统且不含升级语境。 Refs: Tests.Godot/tests/Tasks/test_task0020_acceptance.gd
overlays 08 的验收清单必须登记本任务 Test-Refs，且这些引用可定位到覆盖商店购买、库存锁定、无升级文案三类行为的测试项。 Refs: Tests.Godot/tests/Tasks/test_task0020_acceptance.gd
进入商店后需将库存锁定状态与已购买记录写入自动存档（autosave）；退出并再次进入时展示结果必须与该持久化状态一致。 Refs: Tests.Godot/tests/Tasks/test_task0020_acceptance.gd
必须提供测试覆盖商店购买与退出再进入后的库存持久化行为，并在验收清单中登记对应测试引用。 Refs: Tests.Godot/tests/Tasks/test_task0020_acceptance.gd
验收必须包含测试断言：商店 UI 文本与本地化内容均不出现升级/Upgrade 字样或等价语境。 Refs: Tests.Godot/tests/Tasks/test_task0020_acceptance.gd
任务测试需实际验证商店 UI 不包含任何升级/Upgrade 相关文案或入口提示。 Refs: Tests.Godot/tests/Tasks/test_task0020_acceptance.gd
test_strategy: Test shop purchases and inventory persistence on exit/re-enter. Verify UI lacks upgrade wording. Refs: ADR-0032, ADR-0010.

title: Implement rest scene with free upgrade option
description: Create Rest.tscn with options including free card upgrade per M1 requirements.
acceptance: 进入 Rest.tscn 时，界面必须同时显示且可选择“升级（免费升级一张卡）”“治疗”“移除诅咒”三项；任一选项缺失、不可见或不可选择即判定失败。 Refs: Tests.Godot/tests/Tasks/test_task0021_acceptance.gd
选择“升级”后，流程必须按“选择一张可升级卡→在 Route A 与 Route B 中二选一→进入确认步骤”推进；在确认前取消时，所有卡牌与资源状态保持不变且不产生升级结果。 Refs: Tests.Godot/tests/Tasks/test_task0021_acceptance.gd
升级确认中的不可逆提示必须由翻译键渲染为有效文案，界面不得显示键名、占位符或异常回退文本；出现任一情况即失败。 Refs: Tests.Godot/tests/Tasks/test_task0021_acceptance.gd
完成升级确认后必须保持“免费升级”语义：不得触发任何支付流程，且不得减少任何可计量资源；若出现收费提示、支付入口或资源扣减则失败。 Refs: Tests.Godot/tests/Scenes/Rest/test_rest_upgrade_no_cost_no_resource_deduction.gd
升级一经确认，在同一流程内必须不可撤销、不可回退且不可恢复为升级前状态；若存在可逆路径或不可逆结果不成立则失败. Refs: Tests.Godot/tests/Scenes/Rest/test_rest_upgrade_confirmation_irreversible.gd
升级确认后必须且仅有被选中的单张卡牌发生升级变化，其他卡牌状态保持不变；若出现未选中卡牌变化或多张卡牌同时变化则判定失败。 Refs: Tests.Godot/tests/Tasks/test_task0021_acceptance.gd
在单次 Rest 场景会话内，免费升级确认最多只能发生一次；首次确认后，升级入口必须被禁用或阻止再次进入。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task0021AcceptanceTests.cs
若用户在同一 Rest 会话中尝试第二次进入升级流程，系统必须拒绝该操作，并保持所有卡牌与资源状态不变。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task0021AcceptanceTests.cs
门禁汇总必须包含 `adr_refs=["ADR-0033", "ADR-0010"]` 且与任务元数据完全一致；缺失或不一致时门禁必须非零退出。 Refs: Tests.Godot/tests/Tasks/test_task0021_acceptance.gd
门禁汇总必须包含 `chapter_refs=["CH01", "CH06", "CH10", "CH07", "CH05"]` 且与任务元数据完全一致；缺失或不一致时门禁必须非零退出。 Refs: Tests.Godot/tests/Tasks/test_task0021_acceptance.gd
本任务 `test_refs` 列出的关键测试与工件必须在本轮执行并输出 `executed/pass_fail` 状态；任一未执行或失败即任务失败。 Refs: Tests.Godot/tests/Tasks/test_task0021_acceptance.gd
若本任务存在可选开关，未启用时必须记录 `executed=false` 与 `pass_fail="skipped"`，且不得被记为通过。 Refs: Tests.Godot/tests/Tasks/test_task0021_acceptance.gd
对于任一必填回链字段、测试证据或工件校验缺失，门禁必须 fail-closed 且非零退出，不得降级为 warning。 Refs: Tests.Godot/tests/Tasks/test_task0021_acceptance.gd
test_strategy: Test upgrade flow and confirmation. Verify upgrade is free and irreversible. Check translation keys. Refs: ADR-0033, ADR-0010.

title: Implement event scene with dark cost examples
description: Create Event.tscn with at least two options and dark cost examples (HP loss, curse card) per M1 requirements.
acceptance: 进入 Event.tscn 时必须同时显示事件标题与描述，并提供不少于两个可选项；这些选项里至少一个执行“立即HP损失”，且至少一个执行“加入诅咒牌”，任一类型缺失即判定不通过。 Refs: Tests.Godot/tests/Tasks/test_task0022_acceptance.gd
每次进入事件时，本次可选项集合必须已锁定且不发生刷新/替换；玩家一旦作出选择，结果必须立即写入，并在退出后再次进入时保持已选状态且不可改选。 Refs: Tests.Godot/tests/Tasks/test_task0022_acceptance.gd
事件标题、描述、选项文本必须全部通过翻译系统提供；切换语言后三类文本必须同步变化，且变化结果可被验证。 Refs: Tests.Godot/tests/Tasks/test_task0022_acceptance.gd
选择“HP损失”代价选项后，当前HP必须在该次选择后立刻减少到可验证的新数值；若HP未变化则判定失败。 Refs: Tests.Godot/tests/Scenes/Event/test_event_scene_hp_loss_cost_applies_immediately.gd

必须提供并可执行测试用例，覆盖事件选项与两类代价应用（HP损失、诅咒牌加入），并对结果进行可重复断言。 Refs: Tests.Godot/tests/Tasks/test_task0022_acceptance.gd

ACCEPTANCE_CHECKLIST 中与本任务相关的验收条目可定位到对应测试文件，并能覆盖“诅咒卡约束验证”与“三条移除路径验证”两类检查。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task0032AcceptanceTests.cs
提供 xUnit 用例，验证诅咒卡仅有单一形态，且升级请求被拒绝并保持原卡状态不变。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task0032AcceptanceTests.cs
提供 xUnit 用例，分别验证商店、休息、事件三条移除路径在执行后目标诅咒卡已不存在，且牌组未新增替换卡。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task0032AcceptanceTests.cs
test_strategy: xUnit tests for curse constraints and removal operations. Refs: ADR-0033.

title: Implement deck operations service (draw/discard/exhaust/retain)
description: Build deterministic deck operations with hand limit 10 and retain rules.
acceptance: DeckService 必须提供 draw/discard/exhaust/retain/shuffle 五类操作；在相同初始状态与相同输入序列下，牌堆/手牌/弃牌堆/消耗区结果必须完全一致且可复现。 Refs: Tests.Godot/tests/Tasks/test_task0033_acceptance.gd
任一流程结算后若手牌数量超过 10，超出部分必须按 instance_id 升序依次移入弃牌堆，且最终手牌数量必须为 10。 Refs: Tests.Godot/tests/Tasks/test_task0033_acceptance.gd
本任务的验收与测试映射必须可追溯，且至少覆盖抽牌顺序、弃牌顺序、EndOfTurn retain 规则与手牌上限溢出行为。 Refs: Tests.Godot/tests/Tasks/test_task0033_acceptance.gd
draw 必须按当前抽牌堆顺序依次将卡实例加入手牌；在不触发上限溢出的情况下，手牌新增顺序与抽牌顺序一致且可被测试验证。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Services/DeckServiceTests.cs
discard 必须将指定卡实例从其当前区域移入弃牌堆；除该实例迁移外，其他卡实例的集合与相对顺序保持不变，若未找到指定实例则状态不变。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Services/DeckServiceTests.cs
exhaust 必须将指定卡实例移入消耗区；该实例在后续抽牌与弃牌循环中不得再次出现。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Services/DeckServiceTests.cs
EndOfTurn 必须应用 retain 规则：标记 retain 的卡实例保留在手牌，未标记实例全部从手牌移入弃牌堆。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Services/DeckServiceTests.cs
shuffle 只允许重排抽牌堆顺序；卡实例总数与成员不变，不得新增或丢失实例，且手牌/弃牌堆/消耗区不受影响。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Services/DeckServiceTests.cs
必须提供 xUnit 用例，至少验证 draw 与 discard 的顺序行为、EndOfTurn retain 行为、以及手牌上限溢出按 instance_id 处理的行为。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Services/DeckServiceTests.cs Game.Core.Tests/Services/DeckServiceHandLimitTests.cs

Task 33 acceptance checklist must explicitly back-link ADR-0021 and ADR-0032 at item or footer level; missing either ADR link fails acceptance. Refs: Tests.Godot/tests/Tasks/test_task0033_acceptance.gd
Gate evaluation must fail when ADR-0021 or ADR-0032 traceability is absent from task evidence or test mapping. Refs: Tests.Godot/tests/Tasks/test_task0033_acceptance.gd
test_strategy: xUnit tests for draw/discard ordering, retain behavior, and hand limit overflow. Refs: ADR-0032.

title: Implement card targeting and drag UX
description: Add hover/drag targeting UX in combat scene.
acceptance: 战斗场景中，鼠标悬停可选中敌方目标；若仅有一个敌人，该敌人始终为当前选中；将卡牌拖拽到目标上会触发出牌尝试；目标不满足时给出明确无效目标反馈；所有提示文本均使用翻译键。 Refs: Tests.Godot/tests/Tasks/test_task0034_acceptance.gd
在 Windows 环境下，悬停选中与拖拽出牌流程可重复执行且不中断，过程中可观察到目标选中与出牌尝试的状态变化。 Refs: Tests.Godot/tests/Tasks/test_task0034_acceptance.gd
Overlay 的 Test-Refs 已更新并指向本任务验收与相关测试清单。 Refs: Tests.Godot/tests/Tasks/test_task0034_acceptance.gd
提供 GdUnit4 测试覆盖目标选择与拖拽出牌流程，并对无效目标反馈作出可观察断言。 Refs: Tests.Godot/tests/Scenes/Battle/test_battle_card_targeting_drag_play_flow.gd Tests.Godot/tests/UI/test_hud_invalid_target_feedback.gd
当目标条件不满足时，出牌尝试被拒绝，手牌与战斗状态保持不变，并显示无效目标反馈。 Refs: Tests.Godot/tests/Tasks/test_task0034_acceptance.gd
[OBL:T34.O3] 当目标满足出牌条件时，将卡牌拖拽到目标上必须成功出牌并从手牌移除对应卡牌。 Refs: Tests.Godot/tests/UI/test_card_drag_target_play.gd
[OBL:T34.O3] 成功出牌后战斗状态必须发生可观察变化（如目标生命值或状态变化），并可被测试断言。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Services/CombatServiceTests.cs Tests.Godot/tests/UI/test_hud_updates_on_events.gd
[OBL:T34.O3] 当目标满足条件时，将卡牌拖拽到目标上必须成功出牌，而非仅触发出牌尝试。 Refs: Tests.Godot/tests/UI/test_card_drag_target_play.gd
test_strategy: GdUnit4 tests for target selection and drag-drop play flow. Refs: ADR-0025.

title: Implement end-of-combat resolution pipeline
description: Finalize victory/defeat resolution and reward handoff.
acceptance: 胜利与失败分支都必须触发战斗结束结算，并产生可验证的状态变化；不得以空操作或无状态变化通过验收。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task0035AcceptanceTests.cs
在 Windows 环境下执行战斗结束结算流程应无崩溃，且可观察到状态改变或场景切换结果；不得静默失败。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task0035AcceptanceTests.cs
Overlay 的 Test-Refs 清单必须包含与本任务相关的测试引用，并与本验收项一致。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task0035AcceptanceTests.cs
胜利结算时必须按顺序完成：解析死亡触发、发放奖励、写入 run state、切换到 Reward 场景；缺任一步骤视为失败。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Services/CombatServiceTests.cs
失败结算时必须结束当前 run 并返回主菜单，且不得进入 Reward 场景。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Services/CombatServiceTests.cs
提供 xUnit 用例覆盖战斗结束结算与状态切换。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task0035AcceptanceTests.cs

Task 35 acceptance must explicitly trace and validate ADR-0032 and ADR-0029 consistency; any conflict with either ADR fails acceptance and blocks progression. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task0035AcceptanceTests.cs
test_strategy: xUnit tests for combat end resolution and state transitions. Refs: ADR-0032.

title: Implement autosave triggers per determinism policy
description: Add autosave on combat start, reward screen open, and event choice.
acceptance: 当战斗进入初始状态、奖励界面首次显示、事件选择作出后，系统分别立即写入 1 次自动存档；除这三类触发外不得产生自动存档。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task0036AcceptanceTests.cs
玩家执行跳过/略过流程时，自动存档计数相对跳过前保持不变，不得新增任何自动存档。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task0036AcceptanceTests.cs
Overlay 08 验收清单中的 Test-Refs 指向本任务相关测试文件或占位，并与“战斗初始、奖励首次显示、事件选择后触发，跳过不新增”语义一致。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task0036AcceptanceTests.cs
xUnit 测试可观测地覆盖自动存档触发时机与存档内容一致性，并验证跳过流程不产生额外自动存档。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task0036AcceptanceTests.cs
Task 36 acceptance must explicitly trace implementation and tests to ADR-0032 and ADR-0023; missing either ADR linkage fails acceptance. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task0036AcceptanceTests.cs
Gate check must fail when ADR-0032 or ADR-0023 back-link evidence is absent from task-0036 outputs or checklist mapping. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task0036AcceptanceTests.cs
test_strategy: xUnit tests for autosave timing and content. Refs: ADR-0032.

title: Single-slot continue metadata and integrity checks
description: Add run metadata, integrity checks, and Continue gating.
acceptance: 单存档在成功保存后，继续加载时必须可读取运行元数据（run_id、difficulty_id、act、node_id、timestamp），且 Continue 判定逻辑使用这些元数据 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task0037AcceptanceTests.cs
加载时必须进行存档结构与完整性校验；若校验失败则阻止 Continue、显示错误提示，并保持既有存档内容不变 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task0037AcceptanceTests.cs
Overlay 验收清单中该任务的 Test-Refs 记录保持对齐且不新增引用 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task0037AcceptanceTests.cs
提供 xUnit 用例覆盖元数据校验与 Continue 门禁 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task0037AcceptanceTests.cs
相关测试在清单中明确标注为 xUnit Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task0037AcceptanceTests.cs
交付物需引用 ADR-0032 与 ADR-0029 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task0037AcceptanceTests.cs
test_strategy: xUnit tests for metadata validation and Continue gating. Refs: ADR-0032.

title: Audit logging for determinism and security events
description: Implement JSONL audit logging to logs/ per SSoT.
acceptance: 执行保存、加载或锁相关流程后，必须在 logs/ci/<YYYY-MM-DD>/security-audit.jsonl 生成审计文件，且路径符合 SSoT 规范。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Services/AuditLoggerJsonlSchemaTests.cs
在 Windows 环境中可直接验证日志写入成功，且 security-audit.jsonl 每一行都可被解析为独立 JSON 对象。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Services/AuditLoggerJsonlSchemaTests.cs
验收需提供可追溯证据（测试结果或日志文件），并能对应 JSONL 字段与路径校验结果。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Services/AuditLoggerJsonlSchemaTests.cs
在 logs/ci/<YYYY-MM-DD>/security-audit.jsonl 中，每条审计记录必须包含 ts、action、reason、target、caller 五个字段，任一字段缺失即不通过。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Services/AuditLoggerJsonlSchemaTests.cs
日志必须至少包含保存、加载、offer lock、拒绝四类事件；触发拒绝场景时必须写入对应 deny 事件且包含 reason。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Services/AuditLoggerEventCoverageTests.cs
提供 xUnit 测试校验 JSONL 行结构与目标路径 logs/ci/<date>/security-audit.jsonl；字段缺失、JSON 不可解析或路径错误时测试必须失败。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Services/AuditLoggerJsonlSchemaTests.cs
提供 AuditLogger（或同等同名组件）作为审计写入入口，并由该入口生成满足上述字段与路径约束的 JSONL 记录。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Services/AuditLoggerJsonlSchemaTests.cs
Task 38 artifacts must explicitly trace to ADR-0019 and ADR-0003; missing either ADR reference fails acceptance. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Services/AuditLoggerJsonlSchemaTests.cs
test_strategy: xUnit tests to verify JSONL schema and file paths. Refs: ADR-0019.

title: Populate translations for M1 cards, relics, events
description: Add translation entries for M1 content and UI text.
acceptance: 为 M1 卡牌/遗物/事件的全部可见文本补齐 en 与 zh-CN 翻译键；资源中可检索到这些键，任一缺失即不通过 Refs: Tests.Godot/tests/Tasks/test_task0039_acceptance.gd
所有 UI 提示/按钮/弹窗等可见文本仅通过翻译键渲染；运行时发现任一硬编码可见文本即不通过 Refs: Tests.Godot/tests/Tasks/test_task0039_acceptance.gd
PRD-NEWROUGE-GAME-0001 overlay 的 Test-Refs 指向本任务验收用例，且可追溯到翻译键存在性与冒烟检查 Refs: Tests.Godot/tests/Tasks/test_task0039_acceptance.gd
为所有 UI 提示/按钮/弹窗等可见文本补齐 en 与 zh-CN 翻译键，任一缺失即不通过 Refs: Tests.Godot/tests/Tasks/test_task0039_acceptance.gd
新增 GdUnit4 冒烟用例覆盖翻译键加载与基础 UI 渲染 Refs: Tests.Godot/tests/Tasks/test_task0039_acceptance.gd
提供脚本或手动检查流程，验证所有引用翻译键存在 Refs: Tests.Godot/tests/Tasks/test_task0039_acceptance.gd
所有可见文本必须通过翻译键渲染，运行时发现任一硬编码可见文本即不通过 Refs: Tests.Godot/tests/Tasks/test_task0039_acceptance.gd

Task 39 artifacts must include explicit ADR-0010 traceability (refs/checklist/test annotation) with auditable linkage points; missing ADR-0010 linkage fails acceptance. Refs: Tests.Godot/tests/Tasks/test_task0039_acceptance.gd
Gate must reject progression when PRD overlay or related tests lack ADR-0010 linkage evidence for Task 39. Refs: Tests.Godot/tests/Tasks/test_task0039_acceptance.gd
test_strategy: Script or manual checks to ensure all referenced keys exist; GdUnit4 smoke. Refs: ADR-0010.

title: Define Act 1 enemy data and definitions
description: Create enemy definitions and data for Act 1 encounters.
acceptance: 提供 Act 1 的普通/精英/首领 EnemyDefinition 数据，包含统计属性与 intent pools；仅为数据定义，不含任何意图选择逻辑。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task0040AcceptanceTests.cs
xUnit 用例验证敌人数据有效且定义列表顺序确定可重复（无随机漂移），可在 Windows 环境运行通过。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task0040AcceptanceTests.cs
若本任务产生 overlay 文档变更，则 Test-Refs 清单与本任务测试一致且可追溯；未产生该类变更则不新增/不改动该清单。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task0040AcceptanceTests.cs
本任务相关改动需显式引用 ADR-0021（代码或文档均可）。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task0040AcceptanceTests.cs
test_strategy: xUnit tests for enemy data validity and deterministic ordering of definitions. Refs: ADR-0021.

title: Implement enemy intent display and preview UI
description: Show enemy next intent in combat UI.
acceptance: 在战斗UI中，每个敌人都显示“下一回合意图”的图标与文字描述；当回合开始触发更新后，显示内容必须与该敌人最新已解析意图数据一致，且不得继续显示上一回合旧意图。 Refs: Tests.Godot/tests/Tasks/test_task0041_acceptance.gd
意图文字必须通过翻译键渲染（非硬编码）；在Windows环境中应显示为正确本地化文本，且不得出现乱码或直接显示未解析键名。 Refs: Tests.Godot/tests/Tasks/test_task0041_acceptance.gd
验收清单中本任务对应条目需明确表达“显示敌人意图与预览UI”的语义，并可据此判定是否已覆盖“图标+描述+回合更新”三个可观察结果。 Refs: Tests.Godot/tests/Tasks/test_task0041_acceptance.gd
使用GdUnit4提供自动化测试，至少验证“敌人意图可见且内容正确”与“回合开始后意图随已解析数据更新”两类行为；任一验证失败则本任务不通过验收。 Refs: Tests.Godot/tests/Tasks/test_task0041_acceptance.gd
test_strategy: GdUnit4 tests for intent display and updates on turn start. Refs: ADR-0025.

title: Map node entry gating and backtracking rules
description: Enforce node selection lock and no backtracking.
acceptance: 进入节点时，节点选项会被锁定；在相同输入下，node_pre_enter 的顺序与内容保持确定性且可通过测试验证。 Refs: Tests.Godot/tests/Tasks/test_task0042_acceptance.gd
在已选择节点后，不允许回退或改选其他节点；相关状态保持不变且可验证。 Refs: Tests.Godot/tests/Tasks/test_task0042_acceptance.gd
Overlay 的 Test-Refs 已包含本任务验收用例，并与“锁定选项 + 禁止回退”的规则一致。 Refs: Tests.Godot/tests/Tasks/test_task0042_acceptance.gd
xUnit：验证进入节点时选项被锁定，且锁定状态不可变。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task0042AcceptanceTests.cs
xUnit：断言在相同输入下锁定状态保持一致。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task0042AcceptanceTests.cs
xUnit：相同输入下 node_pre_enter 的顺序与内容完全一致。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task0042AcceptanceTests.cs
xUnit：不同输入下，node_pre_enter 的顺序与内容按规则变化并可断言。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task0042AcceptanceTests.cs
test_strategy: xUnit tests for node selection lock and deterministic node order. Refs: ADR-0032.

title: Run state machine with Command-only transitions
description: Implement run state transitions via Command entries only.
acceptance: 通过仅处理 Command 入口完成运行状态迁移的状态机已经实现，并有对应可追溯测试覆盖。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task0043AcceptanceTests.cs
在 Windows 环境下可运行 xUnit，用例验证命令驱动的迁移顺序与状态不变式，结果可判定。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task0043AcceptanceTests.cs
Overlay 的 Test-Refs 指向本任务测试路径且可追溯。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task0043AcceptanceTests.cs
在相同初始状态与相同 Command 顺序下处理命令，得到的运行状态序列与最终状态一致，并可由测试验证。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/State/GameStateMachineTests.cs
任何对外可观察的运行状态变更仅在处理 Command 时发生；未处理 Command 的调用保持运行状态不变。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/State/GameStateMachineTests.cs Game.Core.Tests/State/GameStateManagerTests.cs
提供可用的 RunStateMachine 与 Command 类型，仅通过 Command 入口触发迁移，并测试至少一个有效迁移与一个无效迁移的结果。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/State/GameStateMachineTests.cs
xUnit 覆盖命令迁移顺序与状态不变式，顺序错误或不变式破坏时测试应失败且可复现。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/State/GameStateMachineTests.cs Game.Core.Tests/State/GameStateManagerTests.cs
文档或测试用例中明确引用 ADR-0032 与 ADR-0021。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task0043AcceptanceTests.cs
test_strategy: xUnit tests for command transition ordering and state invariants. Refs: ADR-0032.

title: Deterministic resume integration tests (headless)

Overlay 的 Test-Refs 明确记录并可追溯到本任务测试路径，且指向路径可定位对应的 headless 验收用例。 Refs: Tests.Godot/tests/Tasks/test_task0044_acceptance.gd
headless GdUnit4 在 reward、shop、event 各场景执行“保存→退出→重进→恢复”，并断言恢复后 offer lock 状态与选择结果与保存前一致。 Refs: Tests.Godot/tests/Integration/test_reward_shop_event_resume_determinism.gd

测试全程不依赖交互式窗口或人工输入，并可在 Windows headless 环境重复执行得到一致通过结果。 Refs: Tests.Godot/tests/Integration/test_reward_shop_event_resume_determinism.gd Tests.Godot/tests/Integration/test_headless_resume_repeatability.gd
headless 套件执行后在 logs/e2e/<date>/ 同时生成并校验 JUnit/XML 与 audit logs；任一缺失或校验失败则验收失败。 Refs: Tests.Godot/tests/Tasks/test_task0044_acceptance.gd

title: Display difficulty in HUD and run summary
description: Show selected difficulty in HUD and run summary UI.
acceptance: HUD 与 Run Summary 均显示本次运行开始时选定的难度；两处文本一致、可见、可读 Refs: Tests.Godot/tests/Tasks/test_task0045_acceptance.gd
从开局到结束，难度显示值保持为开局选定值；无论流程或操作如何变化，HUD 与 Run Summary 中的值均不改变 Refs: Tests.Godot/tests/Tasks/test_task0045_acceptance.gd
HUD 与 Run Summary 的难度文本必须由翻译键获取并渲染；界面中不存在直接硬编码的难度字符串 Refs: Tests.Godot/tests/Tasks/test_task0045_acceptance.gd

Run Summary 面板在结算/总结阶段存在且可见（至少一个可见节点）；可被测试定位并验证 Refs: Tests.Godot/tests/Tasks/test_task0045_acceptance.gd

title: Implement offer locking generation using RNG streams
description: Generate and lock offer candidates using RNG streams and provenance.
acceptance: 在给定同一 RNG 流与相同输入时，系统必须生成 offer 候选并完成锁定；持久化的 provenance 可被读取并用于重现同一批结果。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task0046AcceptanceTests.cs
在 Windows 环境运行 xUnit 用例时，锁定结果在重载前后必须一致，且该用例集全部通过。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task0046AcceptanceTests.cs
Overlay 的 Test-Refs 必须明确指向本任务测试路径，并能从文档定位到可执行用例实现。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task0046AcceptanceTests.cs
OfferService 在给定 RNG 流与输入时必须返回可查询候选集合；候选数量与内容对外可观察，禁止出现无结果且无错误反馈。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Services/OfferServiceTests.cs
首次锁定后 stable_id 与 display_order 必须被持久化；在相同输入与相同 RNG 流下重载并再次生成时，两者保持不变。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Services/OfferServiceTests.cs Game.Core.Tests/Repositories/OfferLockRepositoryTests.cs
对已锁定的 offer 再次触发生成/锁定时，既有 stable_id 与 display_order 必须保持原值，不得被改写。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Services/OfferServiceTests.cs
provenance 必须持久化且可查询，并至少包含可用于一致性断言的关键信息（如 RNG 流标识与生成批次）。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Repositories/OfferProvenanceRepositoryTests.cs Game.Core.Tests/Services/OfferServiceTests.cs
xUnit 测试必须包含“重载前后锁定结果一致性”的明确断言，且通过/失败可直接反映该条件是否成立。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Services/OfferServiceTests.cs
门禁汇总必须包含 `adr_refs=["ADR-0032"]` 且与任务元数据完全一致；缺失或不一致时门禁必须非零退出。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task0046AcceptanceTests.cs

本任务 `test_refs` 列出的关键测试与工件必须在本轮执行并输出 `executed/pass_fail` 状态；任一未执行或失败即任务失败。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task0046AcceptanceTests.cs
若本任务存在可选开关，未启用时必须记录 `executed=false` 与 `pass_fail="skipped"`，且不得被记为通过。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task0046AcceptanceTests.cs
对于任一必填回链字段、测试证据或工件校验缺失，门禁必须 fail-closed 且非零退出，不得降级为 warning。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task0046AcceptanceTests.cs
test_strategy: xUnit tests for offer lock determinism across reloads. Refs: ADR-0032.

title: Implement status trigger ordering and fixed damage rules
description: Add deterministic trigger ordering and fixed damage behavior.
acceptance: 在相同初始战斗状态与相同事件输入下，状态/遗物触发顺序必须稳定可复现；重复结算得到一致触发序列与一致结果，且不得受集合遍历顺序或随机性影响 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task0047AcceptanceTests.cs
固定伤害规则可被测试证伪：例如 OverplayTax 伤害在结算后保持原值，不受增伤/减伤等修饰影响；需有 xUnit 用例断言该不变性 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task0047AcceptanceTests.cs
Overlay 验收清单的对应条目必须与本任务语义对齐，并可明确核对到“触发顺序确定性”和“固定伤害不被修饰”两项要求 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task0047AcceptanceTests.cs

结算需可区分固定伤害与非固定伤害：固定伤害保持原值，非固定伤害继续按常规修饰规则变化，且该差异可由测试直接断言 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Services/FixedDamageRulesTests.cs
gameplay:6: 触发顺序必须由 xUnit 用例验证，断言既定排序规则与实际触发序列逐项一致；若不一致则测试失败 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task0047AcceptanceTests.cs
门禁汇总必须包含 `adr_refs=["ADR-0029", "ADR-0032"]` 且与任务元数据完全一致；缺失或不一致时门禁必须非零退出。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task0047AcceptanceTests.cs
门禁汇总必须包含 `chapter_refs=["CH01", "CH06", "CH07", "CH05"]` 且与任务元数据完全一致；缺失或不一致时门禁必须非零退出。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task0047AcceptanceTests.cs

对于任一必填回链字段、测试证据或工件校验缺失，门禁必须 fail-closed 且非零退出，不得降级为 warning。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task0047AcceptanceTests.cs
test_strategy: xUnit tests for trigger ordering and fixed damage invariants. Refs: ADR-0029.

title: Implement damage calculation and AOE ordering
description: Add damage calculation, AOE ordering, and multi-hit resolution.
acceptance: 在给定基础伤害与 Strength/Weak/Vulnerable 状态时，最终伤害必须按乘数规则计算，并输出可由测试直接断言的确定数值。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task0048AcceptanceTests.cs
当同一 AOE 命中多个目标时，处理顺序必须严格按 combatant_id 升序，且顺序可通过测试观测并断言。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task0048AcceptanceTests.cs
多段命中解析必须对每一段产生可观察的执行顺序与结算结果，测试可逐段断言。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task0048AcceptanceTests.cs
xUnit 测试必须覆盖 Strength/Weak/Vulnerable 对伤害结算的影响，并对最终输出数值进行断言。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task0048AcceptanceTests.cs
xUnit 测试必须覆盖多段命中的结算顺序与结果，并可对顺序和结果分别断言。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task0048AcceptanceTests.cs
在多段命中中，每一段伤害都必须独立应用 Strength/Weak/Vulnerable 乘数规则，逐段计算结果可被断言。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task0048AcceptanceTests.cs
xUnit 测试必须断言 AOE 处理顺序为 combatant_id 升序；对同一输入重复执行时断言结果保持稳定一致。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task0048AcceptanceTests.cs

Review gate must verify damage multiplier and deterministic ordering behavior do not deviate from ADR-0021/ADR-0032 semantics; any deviation fails acceptance and blocks progression. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task0048AcceptanceTests.cs
test_strategy: xUnit tests for damage calculations and multi-hit ordering. Refs: ADR-0032.

title: Implement stability safeguards for combat loop
description: Add safety limits (100 cards per turn) and failure handling.
acceptance: 当单回合出牌计数超过100张时，战斗循环必须触发硬上限并走失败处理路径，且结果可被验证。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task0049AcceptanceTests.cs
在Windows环境下，硬上限与失败处理触发后必须产生可观察结果（如状态、返回值或日志），可通过测试断言。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task0049AcceptanceTests.cs
验收清单必须能定位到本任务用例索引，且索引可用于核对“超过100张硬停止”与“失败处理”结果。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task0049AcceptanceTests.cs
当同一回合出牌尝试超过100张时，系统必须立即硬停止后续出牌请求，回合/战斗状态保持一致且不崩溃。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Services/CombatServiceTests.cs
触发硬停止时，系统必须记录可查询的审计条目，并能从日志确认触发原因为超过单回合上限。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Services/CombatServiceTests.cs
对无效出牌请求，系统必须返回明确失败结果，不改变已确认状态，且不得抛出未处理异常。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Services/CombatServiceTests.cs
必须存在xUnit用例，验证“超过100张出牌尝试”会触发硬停止而非继续处理。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task0049AcceptanceTests.cs

门禁汇总必须包含 `chapter_refs=["CH01", "CH06", "CH02", "CH07"]` 且与任务元数据完全一致；缺失或不一致时门禁必须非零退出。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task0049AcceptanceTests.cs

title: Implement save migration validation and failure blocking
description: Add migration checks and block Continue on invalid save.
acceptance: 读取存档时必须校验 schema_version；若需迁移则执行迁移；迁移成功时 Continue 可用；迁移失败时 Continue 必须保持不可用且不得进入游戏流程。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task0050AcceptanceTests.cs
在 Windows 环境下的 xUnit 用例需覆盖“迁移失败会阻断 Continue 且错误提示可见”的路径，并能从测试结果验证失败分支确实被阻断。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task0050AcceptanceTests.cs
Overlay 的 Test-Refs 需要指向本任务相关测试文件，以对齐验收清单。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task0050AcceptanceTests.cs
Windows xUnit must verify schema_version migration failure blocks Continue and keeps the entry inaccessible until migration is repaired. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task0050AcceptanceTests.cs

Task 50 implementation and acceptance must explicitly satisfy ADR-0032 and ADR-0023 constraints; missing either ADR traceability fails acceptance. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task0050AcceptanceTests.cs

Review evidence for Task 50 must provide auditable mapping to ADR-0032 and ADR-0023 in test artifacts or checklist refs; missing mapping fails acceptance. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task0050AcceptanceTests.cs

title: Integrate combat turn flow and persistence
description: Wire combat turn flow to core services and save points.
acceptance: 当流程从非战斗状态进入战斗状态时，核心服务必须且仅触发一次起始自动保存；保存存储中可观测到且仅可观测到一条与本次进入战斗对应的新增记录。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task0051AcceptanceTests.cs
每次满足前置条件的回合推进请求都必须经核心服务成功更新回合计数与当前行动者；任一前置条件不满足时必须返回不可推进结果，且回合计数与当前行动者保持推进前值。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task0051AcceptanceTests.cs
仅当判定达到回合结束条件时才执行回合结束清理，并产生可观测状态变化或事件；未达到条件时不得触发清理，且相关状态保持不变。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task0051AcceptanceTests.cs
从起始自动保存恢复后，回合计数与当前行动者必须与保存快照完全一致；在恢复态发起一次合法推进后，系统必须进入下一个有效回合状态。 Refs: Tests.Godot/tests/Adapters/Db/test_savegame_persistence_cross_restart.gd

回合结束清理必须由核心服务直接执行或由其统一触发；每次清理都必须留下可检索记录或事件，用于持久化核验与流程追踪。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task0051AcceptanceTests.cs

title: Implement enemy intent selection logic
description: Add deterministic intent selection rules per enemy.
acceptance: 在至少一组覆盖不同敌人的战斗状态样例中，意图选择必须由“该敌人的规则 + 当前战斗状态”共同决定且结果可核验；若同一敌人在不同状态下仍固定返回单一意图，则判定不通过。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task0052AcceptanceTests.cs
在相同敌人、相同RNG流输入、相同战斗状态条件下，重复执行意图选择的结果必须完全一致；当RNG流输入或战斗状态任一变化时，必须基于新输入重新计算，并在至少一组样例中观察到结果差异。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task0052AcceptanceTests.cs
已新增或更新xUnit用例，明确覆盖“同敌人+同输入结果一致”与“输入变化可触发差异”的确定性行为，并在Test-Refs清单中可追溯到对应测试文件。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task0052AcceptanceTests.cs

Acceptance explicitly records chapter alignment: CH01/CH06/CH07/CH10. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task53HeadlessRunnerCliValidationTests.cs

Local Windows validation must specify and record a known-good scene path; missing known-good scene path fails acceptance. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task53HeadlessRunnerCliValidationTests.cs

The same acceptance record must include run command, exit code, and verification results for all three artifacts (headless.out.log, headless.err.log, summary.json) for the known-good scene run. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task53HeadlessRunnerCliValidationTests.cs

Overlay index file `docs/architecture/overlays/PRD-NEWROUGE-GAME-0001/08/_index.md` must include Task 53 back-link with strict/non-strict behavior and artifact entry points; missing entry fails acceptance. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task53HeadlessRunnerCliValidationTests.cs

Feature slice file `docs/architecture/overlays/PRD-NEWROUGE-GAME-0001/08/08-Feature-Slice-M1-Warrior.md` must include Task 53 Test-Refs and acceptance conclusion aligned with ACCEPTANCE_CHECKLIST.md; any mismatch fails acceptance. title: Integrate GdUnit4 suites into quality_gates.py
description: Extend scripts/python/quality_gates.py to optionally run selected GdUnit4 suites (adapters/security as hard gate, integration/UI as soft gate) and aggregate results into a single summary JSON. Source: docs/migration/Phase-13-Quality-Gates-Backlog.md (B2).
acceptance: 在 Windows 环境运行 quality_gates.py 且启用 GdUnit4 参数时，必须在同次执行记录中看到被选 suite 的执行结果与门禁类型；未启用该参数时，必须将对应 suite 明确标记为未运行，并写入 logs/ci/<date>/task-0054.json。 Refs: Tests.Godot/tests/Integration/test_quality_gates_gdunit_suite_wiring.gd

在 Windows/PowerShell 下，quality_gates.py 必须能解析并实际执行 GdUnit4 相关参数；脚本退出码必须与总体门禁结论一致（通过=0，失败=非0），并将结果写入 logs/ci/<date>/task-0054.json。 Refs: Tests.Godot/tests/Integration/test_quality_gates_gdunit_suite_wiring.gd
Overlay 文档的 Test-Refs 必须覆盖与 GdUnit4 接线相关的验证项，且每一项都能回链到本任务描述或测试策略，避免引入与本任务无关的引用。 Refs: Tests.Godot/tests/Integration/test_quality_gates_gdunit_suite_wiring.gd

quality_gates.py 必须提供参数以显式选择是否运行 GdUnit4 suites，并在结果中区分 adapters/security 与 integration/UI 两类 suites。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task54GdUnitGatePolicyTests.cs Tests.Godot/tests/Integration/test_quality_gates_gdunit_suite_wiring.gd
adapters/security suites 任一失败必须导致总体门禁失败；integration/UI suites 失败仅记录为软门禁，不阻断总体通过。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task54QualityGateSummaryTests.cs
执行后必须生成单一机器可读 summary JSON，包含各 suite 状态、门禁级别与总体门禁结论，并输出到 logs/ci/<date>/quality-gates/summary.json。 Refs: Tests.Godot/tests/Integration/test_gdunit_junit_artifact_export.gd

GdUnit4 的 JUnit/XML 输出必须写入 logs/e2e/<date>/gdunit/junit.xml；若未生成该文件，summary 必须明确记录未生成原因。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task54CiDecisionSyncTests.cs Tests.Godot/tests/Integration/test_quality_gates_gdunit_suite_wiring.gd

本地分别在开启与关闭 GdUnit4 参数运行 quality_gates.py 时，summary 中 suites 状态必须可区分为已运行与未运行，不能以缺失字段代替。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task54GdUnitSuiteSelectionTests.cs Tests.Godot/tests/Integration/test_quality_gates_gdunit_suite_wiring.gd
CI 任务必须以 summary JSON 的总体门禁结论作为 pass/fail 判定依据，且结论变化时 CI 结果同步变化。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task54CiDecisionSyncTests.cs
Test-Refs 列表必须包含 logs/ci/<date>/quality-gates/summary.json 与 logs/e2e/<date>/gdunit/junit.xml，且路径与实际产物一致。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task54GdUnitGatePolicyTests.cs

Test-Refs 列表必须包含 Tests.Godot/tests/ci/test_gdunit_suite_wiring.gd 与 Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task32AcceptanceTests.cs，并可对应到本任务验收项。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task54CiDecisionSyncTests.cs Tests.Godot/tests/Integration/test_quality_gates_gdunit_suite_wiring.gd
在 ACCEPTANCE_CHECKLIST.md 中必须明确列出 ADR-0005、ADR-0011、ADR-0024 作为本任务门禁语义口径引用。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task54QualityGateSummaryTests.cs
test_strategy: Run quality_gates.py locally with and without GdUnit4 flags to verify behavior.
Validate CI job consumes the summary JSON for pass/fail decisions.

title: Coverage thresholds as configurable soft/hard gate
description: Align xUnit coverage thresholds to the blueprint target (lines >= 90%, branches >= 85%) and allow overriding via environment variables. Provide soft/hard gate modes in scripts/python/run_dotnet.py and scripts/python/quality_gates.py.
acceptance: 未设置覆盖率环境变量时，run_dotnet.py 与 quality_gates.py 的有效阈值必须解析为 lines>=90 且 branches>=85，并在执行结果中可复核；任一脚本默认阈值不匹配即判定失败。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task55CoverageThresholdOverridesTests.cs
在 Windows 执行脚本时，临时设置阈值与门禁模式环境变量后，结果必须体现非默认有效阈值，且无需修改代码即可复现；若必须改代码才能得到非默认结果则判定失败。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task55CoverageThresholdOverridesTests.cs
overlay 的 Test-Refs 与验收条目必须同时覆盖“阈值可覆盖、soft/hard 行为、摘要产出”三项义务，并与任务语义逐项对齐；缺失任一项即判定失败。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task55CoverageThresholdOverridesTests.cs

scripts/python/run_dotnet.py 与 scripts/python/quality_gates.py 在未设置覆盖率环境变量时默认使用 lines>=90、branches>=85；设置环境变量后必须采用覆盖后的有效阈值，并可在不改代码前提下完成一次非默认阈值验证。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task55CoverageThresholdOverridesTests.cs
两脚本必须支持 soft/hard gate 选择：覆盖率低于有效阈值时，soft 模式以退出码 0 完成且记录 warning，hard 模式以非 0 退出；覆盖率达到或超过有效阈值时，两种模式均以退出码 0 完成。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task55CoverageGateModeSoftHardTests.cs

覆盖率结果必须输出单一机器可读 JSON 摘要，至少包含实际 line/branch 覆盖率、有效阈值（环境变量覆盖后）、gate mode 与 pass/fail，并分别生成于 logs/unit/<date>/summary.json 与 logs/ci/<date>/quality-gates/summary.json。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task55CoverageSummaryJsonEmissionTests.cs
产出文档或记录必须可追溯到 ADR-0005 与 CH07，且本任务验收范围仅限覆盖率阈值配置、门禁行为与摘要产出；若出现无关新增要求则判定失败。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task55CoverageTraceabilityTests.cs Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task55CoverageScopeGuardTests.cs
overlay 验收清单必须显式标注 ADR-0005 与 CH07 的关联，并保持条目范围与本任务一致；缺少关联或引入超范围条目即判定失败。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task55CoverageThresholdOverridesTests.cs
在 Windows 上执行 dotnet test，并通过临时环境变量验证阈值覆盖与 soft/hard 门禁行为；若结果不可复现或无法区分两种模式则判定失败。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task55CoverageThresholdOverridesTests.cs

overlay 文档必须记录 ADR-0005 与 CH07 的可追溯信息，并覆盖 docs/architecture/overlays/PRD-NEWROUGE-GAME-0001/08/ACCEPTANCE_CHECKLIST.md 与 docs/architecture/overlays/PRD-NEWROUGE-GAME-0001/08/08-Contracts-Quality-Metrics.md 两处；任一缺失即判定失败。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task55CoverageThresholdOverridesTests.cs

验收条目必须显式列出并可审计绑定以下 Test-Refs：Tests/CI/CoverageThresholdOverridesTests.cs、Tests/CI/CoverageGateModeSoftHardTests.cs、Tests/CI/CoverageSummaryJsonEmissionTests.cs；缺失任一文件路径即判定失败。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task55CoverageThresholdOverridesTests.cs
上述三份测试必须分别覆盖“阈值可覆盖”“soft/hard 行为”“摘要 JSON 产出”，并在执行记录中可逐项核对。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task55CoverageThresholdOverridesTests.cs
test_strategy: Run dotnet tests on Windows and verify threshold behavior by temporarily setting env vars.

title: Audit JSONL validation + gate integration
description: Add a Python validator for security audit JSONL outputs and integrate it into the quality gates flow.
acceptance: Provide scripts/python/validate_audit_logs.py to validate security-audit JSONL line-by-line (structure + required fields); any invalid row must return non-zero and must not be treated as passed. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task0056AcceptanceTests.cs
On validation failure, output must include exact line numbers and actionable fix reasons so the broken JSONL rows can be repaired directly. Refs: Tests/CI/AuditLogs/ValidateAuditLogsTests.cs
quality_gates.py must invoke the audit validator when enabled and persist actual executed/pass_fail results into task-0056 summary JSON. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task0056AcceptanceTests.cs

When audit validation is enabled and validate_audit_logs.py fails, quality_gates.py must exit non-zero and block downstream release path. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task0056AcceptanceTests.cs, Tests/CI/AuditLogs/ValidateAuditLogsTests.cs
Provide valid and invalid JSONL fixtures and reproduce one passing and one failing run on Windows. Refs: Tests/CI/AuditLogs/ValidateAuditLogsTests.cs

When audit validation is disabled, quality_gates.py must not invoke validate_audit_logs.py and must write executed=false and pass_fail="skipped" into task-0056 summary. Refs: Tests/CI/AuditLogs/ValidateAuditLogsTests.cs
test_strategy: Use valid/invalid JSONL fixtures to reproduce one pass and one fail run on Windows.

title: Traceability gate for ADR/Chapter/Overlay links
description: Split from T56: enforce ADR, chapter, and overlay Test-Refs traceability as a dedicated gate task.
acceptance: task-0057-traceability.json must record pass/fail results for ADR-0019, ADR-0003, and ADR-0005 trace checks. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task57TraceabilityGateTests.cs
task-0057-traceability.json must record pass/fail results for chapter trace checks CH02, CH03, and CH07. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task57TraceabilityGateTests.cs
Overlay files _index.md, 08-Feature-Slice-M1-Warrior.md, and ACCEPTANCE_CHECKLIST.md must all contain searchable T56/T57 Test-Refs entries. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task57TraceabilityGateTests.cs
Any ADR/chapter/overlay trace mismatch must fail the traceability gate with non-zero exit and block downstream release steps. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task57TraceabilityGateTests.cs
Traceability output must include machine-readable missing/mismatch diff items with concrete file/key locations. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task57TraceabilityGateTests.cs
Traceability check must run on Windows and output platform=windows in task-0057-traceability.json. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task57TraceabilityGateTests.cs

The test strategy must execute one pass sample and one fail sample; pass must exit 0 without mismatch, fail must exit non-zero with mismatch diff. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task57TraceabilityGateTests.cs

Task57TraceabilityGateTests.cs must cover ADR/chapter/overlay checks and assertions must match task-0057-traceability.json pass/fail and diff output. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task57TraceabilityGateTests.cs

Traceability gate must run as a dedicated CI job or dedicated command; if this gate is skipped, unrecognized, or not executed, pipeline must fail before release stages. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task57TraceabilityGateTests.cs

Gate must explicitly validate consistency across tasks.json ADR/chapter refs and overlay Test-Refs anchors (bidirectional): missing or mismatched links in either direction must fail with non-zero exit. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task57TraceabilityGateTests.cs scripts/python/check_tasks_all_refs.py scripts/python/validate_task_master_triplet.py

Traceability gate must validate full linkage consistency among task adr_refs/chapter_refs/overlay_refs and overlay 08 Test-Refs anchors (_index.md, 08-Feature-Slice-M1-Warrior.md, ACCEPTANCE_CHECKLIST.md); any missing, stale, or mismatched link must fail with non-zero exit and emit machine-readable diffs. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task57TraceabilityGateTests.cs scripts/python/check_tasks_all_refs.py scripts/python/validate_task_master_triplet.py

Validator must parse and compare these exact fields for Task 57: tasks.json master.adrRefs/chapterRefs/overlay, tasks_back.json and tasks_gameplay.json adr_refs/chapter_refs/overlay_refs, and overlay 08 Test-Refs entries; the consistency scope must include ADR refs, chapter refs, overlay refs, and Test-Refs path anchors. Any mismatch or missing item in this scope must fail gate with non-zero exit and JSON diff evidence. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task57TraceabilityGateTests.cs scripts/python/check_tasks_all_refs.py scripts/python/validate_task_master_triplet.py

必须校验 ADR / 章节 / Overlay Test-Refs 一致性：对比 tasks.json 与 tasks_back.json/tasks_gameplay.json 以及 overlay 文档中的 Test-Refs，任一缺失、错链、过期链接都必须判定失败并输出 diff。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task57TraceabilityGateTests.cs scripts/python/check_tasks_all_refs.py scripts/python/validate_task_master_triplet.py

The dedicated validator must compare all required link domains declared by the task metadata against overlay documents, emit JSON diff entries for every missing/stale/mismatched link, and return non-zero when any diff exists. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task57TraceabilityGateTests.cs

Dedicated checker must compare three required link groups across task metadata and project docs, emit machine-readable diffs for missing/stale/mismatched links, and return non-zero when any mismatch exists. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task57TraceabilityGateTests.cs
test_strategy: Run traceability check on Windows with one pass sample and one fail sample.
